channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: Agent Distraction
item.description: Analysis of over 913,000 coding agent sessions reveals that 13% expose agents to inline TODO(b/...) comments In 6% of encounters, agents act on these comments, with 83% being entirely unprompted by the developer Higher-capability models show higher distraction rates, highlighting the need for automated cleanup and linters to maintain agent-friendly codebases

item.title: The post-quantum future of web privacy
item.description: Cryptographic protocols like Privacy Pass help keep web sites safe from abuse while keeping their users private This post looks at the quantum threat to these protocols, and some new post-quantum cryptography that may help close the gap.

item.title: Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture
item.description: GitHub's new Git storage architecture is built so thousands of agents can push to a single repository at once The post Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
